component.name: WM Pass
component.summary: Password manager that keeps its vault on your own devices

description.p: WM Pass keeps passwords, one-time codes, cards, notes and SSH keys in an encrypted vault file. Nothing leaves your computer unless you connect a sync or backup destination.

ul.li: Fills logins in your browser through the WM Pass extension
Acts as an SSH agent while the vault is open
Syncs by file, over your local network, or through a server you run
Imports from KeePass, Bitwarden, 1Password and many others
